description: The bound one is tied to its threshold and will not yield it. When the boundary is threatened or crossed, it braces and refuses the trespass, and those who press against it find their every effort blunted and turned aside.

magicEffects.Description: The bound one stands; intruders find their effort blunted.

name: Pause at the Stream
triggerText: When the warded being is brought to the edge of running water.
description: Running water is an old ward against such things, and this one cannot defy it. Brought to the edge of a moving stream, the being falters and stalls, weakened by the current and unable to set foot across while the water runs.

magicEffects.Description: The being falters at the water; cannot pass while it runs.

name: Recoil from the Bell
triggerText: When a bell is rung within hearing of the warded being.
description: The toll of a consecrated bell is poison to the being's nature. When one rings within hearing, the sound staggers it and drives it back, the ringing weakening it and forcing it to withdraw from the place the peal can reach.

magicEffects.Description: The being recoils, weakened by the ringing.

name: Withdraw from the Salt
triggerText: When salt is placed or thrown against the warded being.
description: Salt is an old barrier, and this being cannot abide it. When salt is laid down or flung against it, the creature recoils from the white line, weakened where the grains touched, and seeks any path the salt has not closed.

magicEffects.Description: The being withdraws from the salted ground, weakened where it touched.

name: Become Caught in the Count
triggerText: When countable items are spilled before the counter.
description: Some compulsions run deeper than will. When countable things are spilled before it, the counter cannot turn away — it is fixed in place, bound to tally every last grain before it can move on, no matter what else demands its attention.

magicEffects.Description: The counter is fixed in place until every grain is accounted for.

name: Bound to the Answer
triggerText: When a direct question is put to the truth-bound being.
description: Put a plain question to this being and it cannot lie. It must answer truly — yet the truth comes shaped to the listener's own asking, and whoever receives the answer finds themselves bound by it, held to the words they drew out.

magicEffects.Description: The being answers truthfully, and the listener is bound to the answer they receive.

name: Hear the Price
triggerText: When a mortal opens an offer to the bargain-bound.
description: A bargain-hungry thing that cannot let an offer go unanswered. The moment a mortal opens a deal within its sight, it locks onto the words and is drawn into the dealing, helpless to walk away even when wiser counsel screams to refuse. The price will be heard, and it will be met.

magicEffects.Description: The bound being engages the offer despite better judgment.

name: Falter in the Sun
triggerText: When direct sunlight strikes the warded being.
description: A creature of dusk and shadow that the open sun unmakes. Where daylight falls full upon it, its strength drains away like water through cupped hands, leaving it slow and faltering. It must flee to whatever darkness it can find before the brightness wears it down to nothing.

magicEffects.Description: The being's strength fades under the open sun.

name: Recoil at the Threshold
triggerText: When the warded being approaches consecrated ground.
description: An unhallowed thing that cannot abide holy ground. As it nears consecrated earth, a creeping doubt and bodily weakness press against it, turning its steps aside at the very threshold. It hesitates, falters, and is driven back from the blessed line it dares not cross.

magicEffects.Description: The being falters; doubt and weakness press it back from the holy line.

name: Find the Old Witness
triggerText: When a mortal who has once seen the being is encountered again.
description: A predator with a long, patient memory for the faces it has touched. When someone who once glimpsed it crosses its path again, recognition flares instantly and the old mark is set anew. For those it has already seen, slipping free a second time grows that much harder.

magicEffects.Description: The witness is recognized and re-marked — escape is harder for the seen.

name: Recoil from the Rowan
triggerText: When rowan is placed against or before the warded being.
description: An old-folklore terror undone by the rowan tree's ward. When that bright wood is laid against it or set in its way, the being flinches and weakens where the branch touched, its power guttering. It is turned aside, recoiling from the simple protection set against it.

magicEffects.Description: The being recoils, weakened where the rowan touched.

name: Slip the Count
triggerText: When witnesses try to count or describe the being's numbers.
description: A slippery wrongness that refuses to be pinned down by mortal reckoning. As witnesses try to count its number or fix its shape in memory, the tallies never agree and no two descriptions match. It slides out of every count, leaving only confusion where certainty should be.

magicEffects.Description: Witnesses come away with different counts, different descriptions.

name: Refuse the Name
triggerText: When the being is asked to name itself or another.
description: A nameless thing that guards the truth of itself above all else. When pressed to name itself or another, it cannot let the true name pass its lips, offering instead false names or stony silence. The listener walks away deceived, the real name still hidden in the dark.

magicEffects.Description: The listener gets a false name; the true name remains hidden.

name: Hold to the Path
triggerText: When the being is asked or forced to leave its appointed route.
description: A being bound forever to one appointed route. When something tries to lure or force it from its way, the path itself pulls back at it, its strength faltering until it returns. Dragged aside, it cannot hold the deviation, and is drawn helplessly back to the road it must walk.

magicEffects.Description: The path-bound is marked by its route; deviation falters and reverses.

name: Open the Door
triggerText: When a stranger asks for shelter or hearing in the proper form.
description: A host shackled by the ancient law of hospitality. When a stranger asks for shelter in the proper, old-spoken form, it cannot refuse them, however ruinous the guest may prove. The door swings open, the welcome is given, and the bond of guest-right closes over both.

magicEffects.Description: The guest is admitted, however unwise; old hospitality binds the host.

name: Pause at the Crossing
triggerText: When the being reaches a crossroads.
description: A wanderer caught by the old power of the crossroads. Where the ways meet, it cannot simply pass; the meeting-place seizes it and it must halt, weakened by the obligation laid upon it. Until the four-wind question is honored, it falters there at the crossing, unable to go on.

magicEffects.Description: The being falters at the meeting of ways, weakened by the obligation.

name: Recoil from the Flame
triggerText: When flame is presented against the warded being.
description: A creature that fire drives back in terror. When an open flame is thrust toward it, the being staggers and recoils, its strength scorched away where the heat reached. It cannot stand its ground against the bare fire, flinching from the light that burns more than skin.

magicEffects.Description: The being staggers, weakened where the flame touched.

name: Recoil from the Hazel
triggerText: When hazel is presented or struck against the warded being.
description: A thing turned aside by the warding hazel. When that protective wood is presented or struck against it, the being shrinks back, its power saps where the branch touched. The plain old charm of the hazel is enough to weaken it and drive it from its course.

magicEffects.Description: The being recoils, weakened by the protective wood.

name: Bound by the Spoken Name
triggerText: When a mortal speaks the being's true name aloud.
description: A creature held fast by the truth of its own name. When a mortal speaks that name aloud, it cannot turn away; it stops, falters, and is dragged around to face the one who called. The spoken word binds it like a chain, and it cannot pretend it did not hear.

magicEffects.Description: The named being turns, hesitates, bound by the spoken truth.

name: Wounded by the Word
triggerText: When devotion-words are spoken plainly within hearing of the warded being.
description: A profane thing that holy words wound like steel. When devotion is spoken plainly within its hearing, each phrase lands like a blow, and it staggers beneath the weight of the prayer. The faith uttered aloud tears at it, leaving it weakened and reeling.

magicEffects.Description: The being is weakened; the spoken devotion lands like a blow.

name: Mend Under the Moon
triggerText: When the wounded being stands under moonlight or open night sky.
description: A night-born thing the moon makes whole again. When it stands beneath open sky in the moon's silver reach, its torn flesh knits closed before the eye and its drained strength flows back. The wounds of the day simply unmake themselves under that cold and healing light.

magicEffects.Description: Wounds mend visibly under the moon's reach.

name: Refuse the Bleeding
triggerText: When the being takes a wound that should bleed.
description: A thing that wears flesh but does not truly bleed. When struck a blow that should open it and spill its life, the wound gapes dry and nothing flows. It takes the hurt without the toll, denying its enemies the comfort of seeing it bleed like any living creature.

magicEffects.Description: The wound is taken; nothing flows from it.

name: Walk Beneath the Water
triggerText: When the being is immersed or forced beneath water.
description: A drowned-water thing to whom the depths are no danger. Forced beneath the surface or sunk into the flood, it neither chokes nor struggles, but walks the riverbed or rises at its own choosing. Water cannot kill it, and those who hoped to drown it wait in vain.

magicEffects.Description: The being moves freely through water; drowning is no threat.

name: Reveal the Tell
triggerText: When a witness notices the missing shadow.
description: A counterfeit of a living person betrayed by one small wrongness — it casts no shadow. When a careful eye marks that absence in the lamplight, the illusion cracks, and the witness suddenly knows the thing before them is not mortal at all. The missing shadow gives it away.

magicEffects.Description: The witness marks the being as not-mortal.

name: Stir the Beasts
triggerText: When animals are within sense-range of the being.
description: A wrongness that beasts sense long before men do. When animals come within range of it, they balk, shy, and bolt in fright, their alarm raising every owner who hears them. The creature cannot pass quietly; the panic of the beasts marks its presence for all the watching.

magicEffects.Description: Local animals mark the being; their owners take notice.

name: Strike Twice
triggerText: When the being engages in combat with hand or limb.
description: A thing of unnatural speed in close combat. When it falls upon a foe with hand or limb, a second blow follows hard on the first before any mortal could recover, the two strikes landing as one. Its enemies reel beneath an onslaught faster than living flesh should manage.

magicEffects.Description: The being delivers an additional strike in the same turn.

name: Take a Companion
triggerText: When the lonely one finds a candidate to fill the empty place.
description: A lonely, aching thing forever seeking to fill an empty place at its side. When it fixes on a likely soul, it reaches out with a terrible warmth, and the chosen feels themselves drawn in, charmed by the offered belonging. Step by step they are pulled into its waiting circle.

magicEffects.Description: The witness is drawn closer, charmed by the offered place.

name: Press Toward the Place
triggerText: When obstacles slow the pilgrim's journey.
description: A driven pilgrim that nothing can turn from its destination. When weight, foul weather, or meddling hands rise to slow it, a fierce new purpose takes hold and the ordinary obstacles simply fall away. It presses onward toward its place as though the world had stopped resisting.

magicEffects.Description: The pilgrim moves with new purpose; ordinary delays fall away.

name: Pronounce the Sentence
triggerText: When a witness has clearly broken the punisher's rule.
description: A grim judge of those who break its law. When it sees a witness plainly transgress the rule it keeps, it pronounces sentence upon them, and the words settle as a curse the wrongdoer cannot shrug off. Punishment is laid down like a verdict, and it clings to the guilty.

magicEffects.Description: The rule-breaker is cursed by the sentence pronounced.

name: Set the Trick
triggerText: When the trickster sees an opening for mischief.
description: A grinning trickster always hunting an opening for mischief. When it spies its chance, it lays a snare of riddle and false choice, and the victim is caught wavering helplessly between two wrong answers. Trapped in its own hesitation, the witness stumbles straight into the trick.

magicEffects.Description: The witness is caught hesitating between two false answers.

name: Seek the Final Rest
triggerText: When the weary one drops its guard, hoping the witness will end it.
description: A weary, ancient thing that secretly longs for its own ending. When it lowers its guard, it does so hoping a witness will deal the last blow, letting its remaining strength bleed away. It weakens deliberately, baring itself, inviting the stroke that would finally let it rest.

magicEffects.Description: The weary one weakens, inviting the final stroke.

name: Open the Way
triggerText: When the liberator finds a soul it judges fit to be freed.
description: A liberator that frees souls it judges ready, by death or by terrible change. When it finds one it deems fit, it lays a mark upon them with a touch, claiming them for release. The chosen are sealed to its purpose, and its path will surely find them again.

magicEffects.Description: The chosen is marked; the liberator's path will find them again.

name: Add to the Work
triggerText: When the maker takes raw matter — material, person, place — for the work.
description: A relentless maker that feeds all things into its endless work — matter, people, places alike. When it lays hold of raw stuff for the labor, it marks the taken thing as its own, woven into the greater design. What it has claimed is hard indeed to wrest back again.

magicEffects.Description: The taken thing is marked as the maker's; reclaim is hard.

name: Carry the Doctrine
triggerText: When the speaker presses the doctrine onto a fresh listener.
description: A tireless preacher that plants its creed in every fresh ear. When it presses its doctrine onto a new listener, the words take root whether or not they were welcome. The hearer departs carrying the message like a stone in the mind, unable to set down what was given them.

magicEffects.Description: The listener carries the message away, weighing it whether they wished to or not.

name: Find the Trail
triggerText: When the seeker catches sign of the lost thing.
description: A single-minded hunter that fastens onto the spoor of what it seeks. When it catches the first sign of the lost thing, it marks that trace and locks its attention upon it, and the sign can no longer be hidden away. From there it follows, undistracted, toward its quarry.

magicEffects.Description: The sign of the lost thing is marked; the seeker follows.

name: Note the Crossing
triggerText: When the witness sees a crossing of the rule, vow, or boundary it watches.
description: A watchful keeper of vows and boundaries that forgets nothing. When it sees someone break the rule it guards, it sets a lasting mark upon the transgressor, fixing them in its memory forever. It will know that face again, and so will every other watcher who shares its vigil.

magicEffects.Description: The crosser is marked; the witness will know them, and so will any who share the watch.
